item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Danish beef patty with roasted potatoes, gravy and soft onions, topped with cress. Served with cucumber salad and pickled beetroot. (6+11+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Wok lo mein with noodles, pork, vegetables and lo mein sauce. Served with Asian slaw and crispy Chinese green beans. (1+2+3+7+8+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Wok lo mein with noodles, pea protein, vegetables and lo mein sauce. Served with Asian slaw and Chinese marinated crispy green beans. (1+2+3+7+8+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Pasta with shellfish in a creamy tomato sauce, served with lemon and parsley. (1+5+6+14+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Pasta with green pesto, rocket, baked cherry tomatoes and Grana. (1+6+9+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Carne desmechada, Colombian pulled beef ragout, served with pasta. (1+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Carne desmechada made with mushrooms, served with pasta. (1+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Tonkatsu, crispy panko-breaded pork chop (gluten-free option available), with steamed rice, fresh cabbage salad and nori sesame crunch. Served with tonkatsu sauce, mustard, pickled vegetables and lemon. (1+2+7+8+11+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Mushroom tonkatsu, crispy panko-breaded portobello mushroom (gluten-free option available), with steamed rice, fresh cabbage salad and nori sesame crunch. Served with tonkatsu sauce, mustard, pickled vegetables and lemon. (1+2+7+8+11+13+15)
